## Tuning Parameters

```{r lrm-param-info, echo=FALSE}
defaults <-
  tibble::tibble(parsnip = "penalty", default = "0")

param <-
  ordinal_reg(penalty = double(0)) |>
  set_engine("lrm") |>
  make_parameter_list(defaults)
```

This model has `r nrow(param)` tuning parameters:

```{r, lrm-param-list, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
param$item
```

`penalty` is passed directly to the native `penalty` argument.

## Translation from parsnip to the original package

`r uses_extension("ordinal_reg", "lrm", "classification")`

```{r lrm-oreg}
library(ordered)

ordinal_reg(penalty = double(0)) |>
  set_engine("lrm") |>
  translate()
```
